United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

description.narrative: The project is titled as ‘’unlock young potential for the sustainable development’’ which will be implemented in all six targeted zobas (administrative regions) by NUEYS in coordination with ministry of education. The main aim of the project is to lay conducive platform to turn promising ideas into practical social solutions and to give an opportunity to the young people with brilliant ideas through an innovative method to turn their ideas into reality. Therefore, the effects of the program will ignite the anticipated movement of encouraging entrepreneurship and stimulate young Eritreans to act on their dreams that helps their communities in the near future. The main activities of the project are namely. exhibition, nationwide call for innovation projects, consultancy, equipping innovation center an additional activity will be providing startup budget to the best projects in order to attract youth to come up with brilliant ideas that can bring sustainable solution to the main problems of the community.it is also a plat form to cultivate inventive creative ideas among young people. Formulation of innovation clubs will take place in all REGIONS. So as 18 clubs with 15-20 members in each club will be formulated. Further for enhancing and upgrading innovation ideas among young people competition will be organized during one-day exhibition time in all targeted zobas and the best ones will be awarded by the regional innovation committee. To this end, regional innovation committee (formulated by NUEYS in three zobas) will be in charge of all innovation activities in their respective regions. Innovation rooms (in existing youth centers will be equipped with different necessary materials including hand tools which can help young people to practice and a center for the development of models initiated by the youth. Finally, the best three project will get financial support (start-up budget) to reach the desired level of production.
